name: Usiacurí (Colombia)
description: Green field with a yellow-bordered light blue rectangle bearing a yellow lozenge with a spider on its web.
history: Municipal flag of Usiacurí, a municipality in the department of Atlántico, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor. Spanish Wikipedia records the flag as adopted on 10 June 1997 (acuerdo 009).

features.role: border of the inner panel and central lozenge
spider on a web on the lozenge
